NEWS UPDATE: Three out of seven colleges from the University of the Philippines Manila (UPM), namely the College of Arts and Sciences (CAS), the College of Pharmacy (CP), and the College of Nursing (CN), have officially endorsed today’s walkout protest.

The walkout will begin at 9 a.m. with assemblies and local actions, while snake rallies will start at 10 a.m. from Henry Sy Hall and CAS.

Afterwards, participating colleges will converge along Pedro Gil St., where the program will commence. This will be followed by a march toward Morayta at 1 p.m. and a program at Mendiola at 2:30 p.m.

#UPMWALKOUT

data.raw_text:
NOW: Members of the UP Diliman community will walk out once more Friday as part of the “National Day of Action Kontra Korapsyon,” in a show of unity with other universities in Metro Manila and across the country.

This is the second time Diliman walked out just this past month. The previous “Black Friday” protest attracted a crowd of over 3,000 people in one of the biggest walkouts in the university since the pandemic.

Friday morning will begin with snake rallies in the local colleges and decentralized protests at 10 a.m. in front of the College of Science Complex, Palma, Vinzons, and Plaridel, before converging at Quezon Hall at 11 a.m. in front of both UP Diliman and the UP System’s seat of administration. UP Manila and UP Los Baños will also hold walkouts on their respective campuses.

For live updates: https://t.co/x6r0yDZkUn

#UPActAgainstCorruption
#UPWalkoutIsNow
